minister.name: Syed Mustafa Kamal
minister.role: Federal Minister for National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination

snapshot.text: Health is largely devolved to the provinces, with a federal ministry for regulation, coordination and national programmes. Polio eradication remains the national priority; the minister wants to shift the system from treatment to prevention.

priorities.title: Polio eradication
priorities.text: At the World Health Assembly in May 2026 the minister repeated that polio eradication is Pakistan's foremost national priority; Pakistan is one of the last countries with wild poliovirus.

priorities.title: Hepatitis C and prevention
priorities.text: The minister called hepatitis C a national emergency and launched the Prime Minister's programme to eliminate it by 2030, alongside a new national strategy that shifts care from treatment to prevention.

priorities.title: Local vaccine production and procurement scrutiny
priorities.text: The ministry is accelerating a local vaccine production project with Asian Development Bank support. In November 2026 the prime minister's inquiry into a vaccine procurement controversy blamed the Border Health Services for breaking procurement rules.

netherlands.text: No bilateral health programme found; contact runs mainly through multilateral channels. Minister Kamal sits on the board of Gavi, which the Netherlands funds, and Pakistan's polio drive relies on GPEI partners.

institutions.name: Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination

timeline.text: Minister says medicine stocks are sufficient for the next five to six months.
New national preventive health strategy announced.
At the World Health Assembly, Pakistan calls polio eradication its foremost priority.
Minister orders faster work on local vaccine production.
Hepatitis C declared a national emergency; elimination targeted by 2030.
Vaccine procurement inquiry report made public; the minister says it found no loss to the government.
